name: Moqui Authentication
summary:
*   Role: Product Manager at HotWax Commerce.
    *   Audience: Enthusiastic Retailer (cares about improvements/new features).
    *   Task: Summarize a cluster of updates into a single cohesive release note entry.
    *   Structure for Features/Enhancements: Problem, Solution, Impact.
    *   Structure for Bug Fixes: "Fixed a bug if [Condition], [Symptom]."
    *   Style Guide:
        *   Simpler is better.
        *   Active voice.
        *   Granular but concise (3-4 sentences for features, 1 for bug fixes).
        *   Tone: Professional, utility-focused.
        *   No "AI Slop" (enhanced, streamlined, seamless, robust).
        *   No exclamation points.
        *   No dev-time bugs mentioned in new features (synthesize as polished experience).
        *   True Bug Fixes: "Fixed a bug if [Condition], [Symptom]."
    *   Input Data: A cluster of PRs related to Moqui-only login environments, permission fetching via Moqui API, cookie/state management, and UI adjustments (hiding "Go to OMS" button).

    *   *Item 1 (receiving#705):* Hide "go to oms" button if Moqui-only login. (UI refinement)
